properties.name: grails.openapi.enabled
properties.description: Whether the OpenAPI description is generated at all.

properties.name: grails.openapi.base-document
properties.description: A resource location, such as classpath:openapi-base.yml, of a YAML or JSON document the description starts from.

properties.name: grails.openapi.display-name
properties.description: The title of the default document, in place of info.app.name.

properties.name: grails.openapi.annotated-only
properties.description: Whether only actions that declare @Operation, or whose controller declares @Tag, are described.

properties.name: grails.openapi.include-form-actions
properties.description: Whether the create and edit actions of a RestfulController, which answer HTML forms, are described.

properties.name: grails.openapi.paths-to-match
properties.description: Ant patterns of the paths the default document describes.

properties.name: grails.openapi.paths-to-exclude
properties.description: Ant patterns of the paths the default document leaves out.

properties.name: grails.openapi.packages-to-scan
properties.description: The packages, with their sub-packages, of the controllers the default document describes.

properties.name: grails.openapi.packages-to-exclude
properties.description: The packages, with their sub-packages, of the controllers the default document leaves out.

properties.name: grails.openapi.produces-to-match
properties.description: The media types an operation of the default document must produce, exactly.

properties.name: grails.openapi.consumes-to-match
properties.description: The media types an operation of the default document must consume, exactly.

properties.name: grails.openapi.headers-to-match
properties.description: The header conditions an operation of the default document must declare, such as Accept-Version=1.0.

properties.name: grails.openapi.groups
properties.description: Groups, each a document of its own, by name, each taking display-name and the same path, package, media type and header settings as the default document.

properties.name: grails.openapi.output-directory
properties.description: Where the generate-open-api command writes the documents.

properties.name: grails.openapi.output-format
properties.description: Whether the generate-open-api command writes yaml or json.
